title: Quick start
text: simulate two correlated responses five covariates, delete values probability increases value . observed values biased sample: missing values larger average observed ones.
code: set.seed(2024) n <- 400 x <- matrix(runif(n * 5), ncol = 5) f <- cbind(10 * sin(pi * x[, 1] * x[, 2]) + 20 * (x[, 3] - 0.5)^2 + 10 * x[, 4] + 5 * x[, 5],            5 * x[, 1] - 8 * x[, 2]^2 + 3 * x[, 3]) y_true <- f + matrix(rnorm(2 * n), ncol = 2) %*% chol(matrix(c(1, 0.6, 0.6, 1), 2))  y <- y_true y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + 1.2 * scale(y_true[, 1])), 1] <- NA y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + 1.2 * scale(y_true[, 2])), 2] <- NA colMeans(is.na(y)) #> [1] 0.2375 0.2625 rbind(observed = colMeans(y, na.rm = TRUE),       missing = c(mean(y_true[is.na(y[, 1]), 1]), mean(y_true[is.na(y[, 2]), 2]))) #>              [,1]      [,2] #> observed 12.77439 0.2265791 #> missing  19.15552 4.3086642

text: vignette("missBART") longer walk-, package website articles, including re-run simulation studies paper. Scripts simulations application paper Examples/.
code: library(missBART)  set.seed(1) n <- 500 x <- matrix(runif(n * 5), ncol = 5) y_true <- cbind(10 * sin(pi * x[, 1] * x[, 2]) + 10 * x[, 4], 5 * x[, 1] - 8 * x[, 2]^2) +   matrix(rnorm(2 * n), ncol = 2)  # large values are more likely to be missing y <- y_true y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + scale(y_true[, 1])), 1] <- NA y[runif(n) < pnorm(-1 + scale(y_true[, 2])), 2] <- NA  fit1 <- missBART1(x, y)                      # probit regression missingness model fit2 <- missBART2(x, y, n_class_trees = 20)  # probit BART missingness model  fit1 head(imputed_values(fit1))   # posterior summaries of the missing responses y_complete <- completed_data(fit1) coef(fit1)                   # probit coefficients: positive = more likely to be missing varimp(fit2)                 # which predictors the missingness trees split on

Missing covariate values allowed missBART2() mvBART(), handled inside trees; missBART1() needs complete covariates. y numeric matrix (vector) responses, NA missing values. x_predict optional covariates make --sample predictions. n_trees, n_reg_trees number trees BART model responses. burn number burn-iterations. iters number posterior samples kept burn-thinning. thin thinning interval. sampler runs burn + thin * iters iterations. predict logical. Make predictions x_predict? tree_prior_params tree prior proposal settings, see tree_list(). hypers hyperparameters BART model responses, see hypers_list(). scale responses standardised fitting; see Details. "center" (default) subtracts mean observed values response divides range, "range" (TRUE) maps response [-0.5, 0.5] Chipman et al. (2010) versions 0.2.0, "none" (FALSE) leaves alone. Unless scale = "none", missBART1() also scales covariates [-0.5, 0.5], B_post refers standardised variables. Everything else returned original scale. include_x, include_y logical. Use x /y predictors missingness? include_y = FALSE assumes responses missing random. show_progress logical. Print iteration count? progress_every often update iteration count. pdp_range, make_pdp missBART2() univariate response: make_pdp = TRUE, latent missingness predictor evaluated grid response values spanning pdp_range (scale data; default observed range) every kept iteration returned pdp_out, grid pdp_grid; apply stats::pnorm() get probability missing. Ignored missBART1(), curves follow directly B_post. mice_impute logical. Initialise missing responses mice::mice()? Otherwise start centre observed range. ymis_update Gaussian update missing responses treats rows partly missing. "conditional" (default) conditions observed responses row. "marginal" draws corresponding margin full-row distribution, written Appendix C.1 paper done versions 0.2.0. two agree univariate responses. Used missBART1(), missBART2() include_y = FALSE. probit_prior gamma prior settings precisions probit coefficients missBART1(), see probit_prior_list(). save_y_pred logical. Keep posterior predictive draws training data (y_pred)? save_z logical. Keep draws latent probit variables (z_post)? keep_trees logical. Keep trees every posterior sample? needed predict() new covariates, partial_dependence() interactions(), can take lot memory. n_chains number chains run different starting values. samples chains returned together, chain giving chain sample; see chain_diagnostics(). cores number chains run parallel (Windows). ... arguments passed tree_list() hypers_list(). Arguments earlier versions longer used ignored. n_class_trees number trees probit BART model missingness indicators. MH_sd standard deviation random-walk proposal missing responses missBART2(). Defaults 0.5 / ncol(y).

title: Joint BART models for responses with non-ignorable missingness — missBART
text: Missingness indicator. Write \(M_{ij} = 1\) response \(j\) observation \(\) missing 0 observed. models use latent variable \(M^*_{ij}\) positive exactly \(M_{ij} = 1\). missBART1() mean \(B^\top Z_i\), positive coefficient B_post means larger values predictor make response likely missing. (Versions 0.2.0, first version paper, used opposite coding.) Prior responses. Following BART package (Sparapani, Spanbauer McCulloch, 2021), default scale = "center" fits \(Y_{ij} = \mu_{0j} + f_j(X_i) + \epsilon_{ij}\), \(\mu_{0j}\) mean observed values response \(j\) terminal node parameters centred zero standard deviation \((\max_j - \min_j) / (2 k \sqrt{K})\) \(K\) trees, \(k = \sqrt{\kappa / (4K)}\) 1.96 default (see hypers_list()). Internally done standardising response, equivalent. probit BART model missBART2() likewise offset \(\mu_{0j} = \Phi^{-1}(\bar M_j)\), probit proportion missing values response \(j\). Tree updates. tree updated grow, prune change proposal accepted Metropolis-Hastings step. acceptance ratio includes proposal ratio grow prune moves.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: samplers behind missBART1() (formerly missBARTprobit()), missBART2() mvBART() now written C++ roughly 80 350 times faster version 0.1.0; see README timings. Results reproducible set.seed(), draws differ version 0.1.0 seed.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: change results relative version 0.1.0. Missingness indicator. models now written M = 1 missing response, latent probit variable positive missing responses. probit coefficients missBART1() (B_post, coef()) latent variables (z_post, pdp_out) therefore opposite sign version 0.1.0: positive coefficient now means larger values make response likely missing. sim_missing_probit() sim_missing_trees() use coding (m 1 missing), min_missing_prop max_missing_prop arguments now really bound proportion missing (defaults 0.1 0.4). Standardisation responses. new default scale = "center" follows BART package (Sparapani, Spanbauer McCulloch, 2021): response offset equal mean observed values, terminal node parameters centred zero standard deviation proportional range response. scale = "range" (TRUE) gives [-0.5, 0.5] scaling version 0.1.0, scale = "none" (FALSE) scaling. probit BART model missBART2() offset equal probit proportion missing values. Proposal ratio. Metropolis-Hastings step trees now includes proposal ratio grow prune moves. Version 0.1.0 accepted ratio prior times likelihood alone. Missing responses partly observed rows. Gaussian update missing responses (missBART1(), missBART2() include_y = FALSE) now conditions observed responses row. Version 0.1.0, Appendix C.1 paper written, draw margin full-row distribution instead, ignores residual correlation observed missing responses row. ymis_update = "marginal" restores old behaviour. two agree univariate responses. Node marginal likelihood. one response, version 0.1.0 computed quadratic form node marginal likelihood sum(Sigma_inv %*% mu^2) rather t(mu) %*% Sigma_inv %*% mu. formula paper now used. Inverse-Wishart degrees freedom parameter-expanded update probit correlation matrix n + p + 1 (Talhouk et al., 2012, usual parameterisation) instead n - p + 3. Prior precisions probit coefficients. One precision drawn covariates one responses, Appendix B paper. Version 0.1.0 drew separate value every coefficient pooled full conditional. Latent probit variables missBART1() one response updated one coordinate time univariate truncated normal full conditionals, instead exact draw multivariate truncated normal TruncatedNormal::rtmvnorm() every row. Tree proposals. Split values always drawn within range covariate still available node. Version 0.1.0 used interval (0, 1) change move root, restricted trees whose deepest node depth 3 grow prune moves. Trees can send missing covariate values left right every split, missingness indicators added covariates missing values. mvBART() now respects hypers$kappa.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: keep_trees = TRUE stores trees every posterior sample (reg_trees, class_trees). , predict() works new covariates (newdata), partial_dependence() gives partial dependence individual conditional expectation curves responses missingness probabilities, interactions() counts often pairs predictors used consecutive splitting rules. n_chains runs several chains different starting values (parallel cores), chain_diagnostics() compares . print() warns chains disagree. Selection models can multimodal, recommended interpreting missBART1() fit. plot() compares distributions imputed observed values (= "imputed") plots fitted observed values squared correlation (= "fit"). assumption ignorable missingness available benchmark response model: include_y = FALSE.

title: missBART 0.2.0
text: New name missBART1(), matching paper; missBARTprobit() still works. Fits class "missBART" print(), summary(), fitted(), predict() coef() methods, helpers imputed_values(), completed_data() varimp(). New arguments ymis_update, probit_prior (see probit_prior_list()), save_y_pred save_z. omega_post (also available sigma_post) always holds full residual covariance matrices original scale. used hold variances scale = TRUE one response. (issue #1 GitHub.) new_y_hat new holds BART mean function x_predict; new_y_post holds posterior predictive draws, . var_imp matrix split counts (iterations predictors) rather list tables; var_imp_reg regression trees. y_miss_accept holds one acceptance rate per missing value rather iterations--values matrix. tau_b longer leading row NA. pdp_range given scale data (used [-0.5, 0.5] scale) defaults observed range; grid returned pdp_grid. pdp_out (missBART2(), univariate response) one element per kept iteration, longer accumulates across iterations. missBART1() longer returns pdp_out; compute curves B_post. trees returned keep_trees = TRUE, compact matrix format, reg_mu, class_mu accepted_trees longer returned. arguments true_trees_data, true_trees_missing, true_change_points true_change_points_miss ignored. Dependencies CholWishart, extraDistr, TruncatedNormal, Matrix, MASS ggplot2 dropped; Rcpp RcppArmadillo added. package pkgdown website (built docs/) quick start vignette articles, including re-run simulation studies paper. unexported plotting helpers plot_posterior() plot_plant_posterior() removed.
